HSS 5 Cihnaviśuddhi by Divākaracandra
NSUG Xc 14/39
oṃ namaḥ śrīhevajrāya ||
% begins [61\verso1']
jñānapradīpe devīnāṃ cihnaviśuddhir udāhṛtā |
yathātattvaṃ krameṇaiva nairuktavidhinā mayā ||
kiṃcit kleśasvarūpeṇa kāñcit tatpratipakṣataḥ |
kāñcit jñānasvabhāvena vakṣyatāṃ puna(?) saṃgrahāt punaḥ ||
sarvajagantirohitamātsaryaviśuddhyā rohitamatasyaḥ | tatkarttānārthena kartrī śraddhādisvabhāve vvā/tā (?) | tasmād vāmadakṣiṇapāṇibhyāṃ rohitakartṛdharā gaurī |
% -jagattirohita-] em., -jagantirohita- MS
% gaurī] em., gaurā MS
sukarotpannakopaviśuddhyā sūkaraḥ || anyasādhane koḍa iti | evam apy eko [']rthaḥ | prathamapakṣe nairuktena sukaraśabdasya dīrghaḥ | dvitīye krodhaśabdasya dhasya ḍabhāvaḥ | ḍamarā upakleśās tatsaṃgrahītāś ca krodhas tatas tadupaśamaviśuddhyā ḍamaruḥ || ḍamarāṇāṃ kleśānāṃ vigamaviśuddhyā vā ḍamaruḥ || ataḥ sūkaraḍamarudharā caurī ||
varāhakṛpīṭadharety anyatra | tathāpi saṃghaṭate saṃjñābhedā tu viśuddhibheda eva ram āvaraṇam āhatavān iti varāhaḥ | varaṃ paramānandam ārohatīti varāhaḥ | advayacittam ity arthaḥ | kṛpaṇībhūtasya cetasaḥ spheṭanaṃ (!) kṛpīṭaṃ | tat dvayaṃ dhārayatīti varāhakṛpīṭadharā ||
% -ānandam ārohatīti] em., -ānandamm ārohatīti MS
% varāhakṛ[62\recto]pīṭadharā
kaṃ sukhaṃ pālayatīti kapālaṃ | niṣprapañcajñānaṃ | padmabhājanam ity arthaḥ | tathāpi tārthāntaraṃ padyate gamyate sākṣātkriyata iti padma<m a>tad eva bhājanaṃ sarvadharmāśrayatvāt | krūratvamalavigamāt kūtmaś (?, =kūrmaś) cittaviśeṣaḥ | tad ubhayaṃ dhārayatīti kapālakūrmadharā vettālī |
yogaḥ śamathavipaśyane tam pāti pibatīti vā yogapātrī prajñā || śuktin ity anyasmin | tathāpi saṃgacchate | śuca[ṃ] śokaṃ tiraskarotīti śuktiḥ prajñaiva yathā rāgavān puruṣo bhujaṅga ity ucyate | tathā karuṇārāgavāṃś cetoviśeṣo 'pi bhujaṅga iti | sarve iti kvacit | sarvaprapañcarahitatvāt madhyaś (?) cetoviśeṣa eva |
tadubhayasya dhāraṇāt yogapātrībhujaṅgadharā ghasmarī ||
apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaṃ spṛśatīti paraśuḥ | śūnyatākaruṇābhinnaṃ bodhicittaṃ kasya sukhasyeśvaraḥ | keśvaraḥ sukharājaḥ | nairuktai vakāralopāt keśaraḥ so 'syāstīti keśarī cittaviśeṣaḥ || si[ṃ]ha iti kvacit || evaṃ ca sarvavikalpān hinastīti siṃhaḥ pṛṣodarāditvāt | so 'pi cittaviśeṣa eva || tat dvayaṃ dhārayatīti paraśukeśaridharā pukkasī ||
tathā hi khkkhiradhvaniyogāt khikkhirā paraśu[62\verso]kādayaḥ (?) || tathānāhatā dhvanir upākhikkhirā tathā'dvayajñānasyāgacchataḥ saṅketadhvanir upo 'nāhatadhvanis tad ayam api khikkhireti || bhikṣyate yācyate sevyata iti bhikṣur nirābhāsajñānaṃ | tad ubhayaṃ dhārayatīti khikkhirābhikṣudharā śavarī ||
lāṅgalatva[¯]t sarvavipakṣabhedakatvāl lāṅgalaṃ samyagjñānaṃ guṇabhogyāt sarvasattveṣu caṅkramaṇāt caṅkrametyādi | kṛtyānuṣṭhānajñānaṃ vā | cakravad vipakṣacchedakatvād vā cakraṃ śūnyatājñānaṃ | taddhāraṇaviśuddhyā lāṅgalavajradharā caṇḍālī ||
sarvamārārisantarjanakaratvāt tarjanīkarā | pareṣāṃ bhedakatvena parair abhedyatvena ca vajrasādharmyād vajraṃ khasamama|jñānaṃ (!) tadākāratvād vajrakarā ḍombī ||
iti cihnaviśuddhiḥ ||
vidhāya saccihnaviśuddhim agrāṃ
devatīgaṇānāṃ paramārtharūpām |
% ˚gaṇānāṃ] em. HI, ˚gaṇāṃ MS
puṇyaṃ samudbhūtam atīva śuddhaṃ
yan me jagat tena jino 'stu śīghram
iti || samāpteyaṃ cihnaviśuddhir iti || kṛtir iyaṃ mahāpaṇḍitācāryaśrīDivākaracandrapādānām iti || o ||
